name: agent-ingest-audit-optimize
description: Review a plugin, a skill, or an MCP server before you adopt it, and audit advice about agent setup against current evidence.

interface.longDescription: Reviews a plugin, a skill, or an MCP server before it is adopted: reads what it ships, checks its claims against current primary sources, compares it with the real setup, and gives a verdict with the risks and the way back. Also audits videos, articles, and repositories about agent setup and turns supported findings into scoped, reversible changes.
defaultPrompt: Review this plugin before I install it.
Is this MCP server safe to adopt in my setup?
Audit this material and verify its recommendations.
